No real student data; fictional \"Learner QA\" only.\n *\n * Uses system chromium via playwright-core so no project dependency is added.\n */\nimport { chromium } from 'playwright-core';\nimport { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';\n\nconst base = process.env.AMINA_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';\nconst exe = process.env.CHROME_PATH || '/usr/bin/chromium';\nconst outDir = process.env.QA_OUT_DIR || 'artifacts/learner-flow';\nawait mkdir(outDir, { recursive: true });\n\nconst report = {\n  mission: 'Issue #9 R3 — learner-flow verification',\n  baseURL: base,\n  startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n  environment: 'local production build (dist + server.ts) on 127.0.0.1:4173; headless system chromium; /api/health hasApiKey=false (degraded AI routes)',\n  syntheticProfile: 'Learner QA (fictional)',\n  phases: [],\n  screens: [],\n  errors: [],\n};\n\nlet stepCount = 0;\nconst step = (label) => { stepCount += 1; return `${stepCount}. ${label}`; };\n\nasync function shot(page, name, viewport) {\n  const file = `${outDir}/${name}.png`;\n  await page.screenshot({ path: file, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});\n  const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({\n    dir: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).direction,\n    docWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,\n    vw: window.innerWidth,\n    nav: document.querySelectorAll('nav button').length,\n    text: (document.body.innerText || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 700),\n  }));\n  report.screens.push({ name, file, viewport, ...state });\n  return state;\n}\n\nasync function phase(id, title, budget, fn) {\n  const record = { id, title, budget, status: 'BLOCKED', steps: [], notes: [], evidence: [] };\n  report.phases.push(record);\n  const start = stepCount;\n  try {\n    await fn({\n      log: (m) => record.steps.push(step(m)),\n      note: (m) => record.notes.push(m),\n      evidence: (m) => record.evidence.push(m),\n      assertBudget: () => { if (stepCount - start >= budget) throw new Error(`PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED after ${budget} steps`);  "new_content": "/**\n * Amina learner-flow verification harness (Issue #9 / R3).\n *\n * Segmentation rationale: the earlier Forera synthetic-learner pass exhausted a hard 24-step\n * cap and stopped mid-onboarding (ADF-009: it clicked a disabled Submit with stale indexes).\n * This harness runs one browser context but splits the work into independent, budgeted phases.\n * A phase that exhausts its budget is recorded BLOCKED without aborting later phases, so the\n * run no longer dies on a single cap. No real student data; fictional \"Learner QA\" only.\n *\n * Uses system chromium via playwright-core so no project dependency is added.\n */\nimport { chromium } from 'playwright-core';\nimport { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';\n\nconst base = process.env.AMINA_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';\nconst exe = process.env.CHROME_PATH || '/usr/bin/chromium';\nconst outDir = process.env.QA_OUT_DIR || 'artifacts/learner-flow';\nawait mkdir(outDir, { recursive: true });\n\nconst report = {\n  mission: 'Issue #9 R3 — learner-flow verification',\n  baseURL: base,\n  startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n  environment: 'local production build (dist + server.ts) on 127.0.0.1:4173; headless system chromium; /api/health hasApiKey=false (degraded AI routes)',\n  syntheticProfile: 'Learner QA (fictional)',\n  phases: [],\n  screens: [],\n  errors: [],\n};\n\nlet stepCount = 0;\nconst step = (label) => { stepCount += 1; return `${stepCount}. ${label}`; };\n\nasync function shot(page, name, viewport) {\n  const file = `${outDir}/${name}.png`;\n  await page.screenshot({ path: file, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});\n  const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({\n    dir: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).direction,\n    docWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,\n    vw: window.innerWidth,\n    nav: document.querySelectorAll('nav button').length,\n    text: (document.body.innerText || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 700),\n  }));\n  report.screens.push({ name, file, viewport, ...state });\n  return state;\n}\n\nasync function phase(id, title, budget, fn) {\n  const record = { id, title, budget, status: 'BLOCKED', steps: [], notes: [], evidence: [] };\n  report.phases.push(record);\n  const start = stepCount;\n  try {\n    await fn({\n      log: (m) => record.steps.push(step(m)),\n      note: (m) => record.notes.push(m),\n      evidence: (m) => record.evidence.push(m),\n      assertBudget: () => { if (stepCount - start >= budget) throw new Error(`PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED after ${budget} steps`); },\n    });\n    record.status = 'PASS';\n  } catch (e) {\n    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);\n    record.status = msg.startsWith('PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED') ? 'BLOCKED' : 'FAIL';\n    record.notes.push(`Error: ${msg.split('\\n')[0]}`);\n  }\n  return record;\n}\n\n/** Click a nav destination, dismissing any open modal overlay first. */\nasync function goTab(page, index) {\n  await page.keyboard.press('Escape').catch(() => {});\n  await page.waitForTimeout(200);\n  const close = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Close|Fermer|إغلاق|Go back|رجوع/i }).first();\n  if (await close.count().catch(() => 0)) {\n    await close.click({ timeout: 1500 }).catch(() => {});\n    await page.waitForTimeout(250);\n  }\n  await page.locator('nav button').nth(index).click({ timeout: 5000, force: true });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(500);\n}\n\n/** Reset the main scroll container to the top (snap feeds keep their own scroll offset). */\nasync function scrollTop(page) {\n  await page.evaluate(() => {\n    document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach((el) => {\n      const s = getComputedStyle(el);\n      if ((s.overflowY === 'auto' || s.overflowY === 'scroll') && el.scrollTop > 0) el.scrollTop = 0;\n    });\n  });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n}\n\nconst browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: exe, headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] });\nasync function newPage(ctx) {\n  const page = await ctx.newPage();\n  page.on('pageerror', (e) => report.errors.push({ type: 'pageerror', message: e.message }));\n  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') report.errors.push({ type: 'console', message: m.text().slice(0, 400) });  "new_content": "/**\n * Amina learner-flow verification harness (Issue #9 / R3).\n *\n * Segmentation rationale: the earlier Forera synthetic-learner pass exhausted a hard 24-step\n * cap and stopped mid-onboarding (ADF-009: it clicked a disabled Submit with stale indexes).\n * This harness runs one browser context but splits the work into independent, budgeted phases.\n * A phase that exhausts its budget is recorded BLOCKED without aborting later phases, so the\n * run no longer dies on a single cap. No real student data; fictional \"Learner QA\" only.\n *\n * Uses system chromium via playwright-core so no project dependency is added.\n */\nimport { chromium } from 'playwright-core';\nimport { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';\n\nconst base = process.env.AMINA_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';\nconst exe = process.env.CHROME_PATH || '/usr/bin/chromium';\nconst outDir = process.env.QA_OUT_DIR || 'artifacts/learner-flow';\nawait mkdir(outDir, { recursive: true });\n\nconst report = {\n  mission: 'Issue #9 R3 — learner-flow verification',\n  baseURL: base,\n  startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n  environment: 'local production build (dist + server.ts) on 127.0.0.1:4173; headless system chromium; /api/health hasApiKey=false (degraded AI routes)',\n  syntheticProfile: 'Learner QA (fictional)',\n  phases: [],\n  screens: [],\n  errors: [],\n};\n\nlet stepCount = 0;\nconst step = (label) => { stepCount += 1; return `${stepCount}. ${label}`; };\n\nasync function shot(page, name, viewport) {\n  const file = `${outDir}/${name}.png`;\n  await page.screenshot({ path: file, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});\n  const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({\n    dir: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).direction,\n    docWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,\n    vw: window.innerWidth,\n    nav: document.querySelectorAll('nav button').length,\n    text: (document.body.innerText || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 700),\n  }));\n  report.screens.push({ name, file, viewport, ...state });\n  return state;\n}\n\nasync function phase(id, title, budget, fn) {\n  const record = { id, title, budget, status: 'BLOCKED', steps: [], notes: [], evidence: [] };\n  report.phases.push(record);\n  const start = stepCount;\n  try {\n    await fn({\n      log: (m) => record.steps.push(step(m)),\n      note: (m) => record.notes.push(m),\n      evidence: (m) => record.evidence.push(m),\n      assertBudget: () => { if (stepCount - start >= budget) throw new Error(`PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED after ${budget} steps`); },\n    });\n    record.status = 'PASS';\n  } catch (e) {\n    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);\n    record.status = msg.startsWith('PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED') ? 'BLOCKED' : 'FAIL';\n    record.notes.push(`Error: ${msg.split('\\n')[0]}`);\n  }\n  return record;\n}\n\n/** Click a nav destination, dismissing any open modal overlay first. */\nasync function goTab(page, index) {\n  await page.keyboard.press('Escape').catch(() => {});\n  await page.waitForTimeout(200);\n  const close = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Close|Fermer|إغلاق|Go back|رجوع/i }).first();\n  if (await close.count().catch(() => 0)) {\n    await close.click({ timeout: 1500 }).catch(() => {});\n    await page.waitForTimeout(250);\n  }\n  await page.locator('nav button').nth(index).click({ timeout: 5000, force: true });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(500);\n}\n\n/** Reset the main scroll container to the top (snap feeds keep their own scroll offset). */\nasync function scrollTop(page) {\n  await page.evaluate(() => {\n    document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach((el) => {\n      const s = getComputedStyle(el);\n      if ((s.overflowY === 'auto' || s.overflowY === 'scroll') && el.scrollTop > 0) el.scrollTop = 0;\n    });\n  });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n}\n\nconst browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: exe, headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] });\nasync function newPage(ctx) {\n  const page = await ctx.newPage();\n  page.on('pageerror', (e) => report.errors.push({ type: 'pageerror', message: e.message }));\n  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') report.errors.push({ type: 'console', message: m.text().slice(0, 400) }); });\n  return page;\n}\n\nconst FINISH = { fr: 'Vérifier & Confirmer le Profil', ar: 'مراجعة وتأكيد الملف الشخصي', en: 'Review & Confirm Profile' };\nconst CONFIRM = { fr: 'Enregistrer & Commencer la Journée', ar: 'حفظ وبدء اليوم الدراسي', en: 'Save Profile & Start Day' };\nconst NAV_SKIP = /^(Back|Next Question|Submit|Retour|Question Suivante|Envoyer|رجوع|السؤال التالي|إرسال)/;\n\nasync function onboard(page, language) {\n  await page.goto(base, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().fill(language === 'ar' ? i < 5; i += 1) {\n    const picked = await page.evaluate((skipSrc) => {\n      const skip = new RegExp(skipSrc);\n      const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter((b) => b.offsetWidth > 0);\n      const preset = btns.find((b) => {\n        const t = (b.innerText || '').trim();\n        return t && !skip.test(t) && !/🇪🇬|🇬🇧|🇫🇷/.test(t);\n      });\n      if (!preset) return null;\n      preset.click();\n      return preset.innerText.trim().slice(0, 40);\n    }, NAV_SKIP.source);\n    if (!picked) { const free = page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').last();  "old_content": "/**\n * Amina learner-flow verification harness (Issue #9 / R3).\n *\n * Segmentation rationale: the earlier Forera synthetic-learner pass exhausted a hard 24-step\n * cap and stopped mid-onboarding (ADF-009: it clicked a disabled Submit with stale indexes).\n * This harness runs one browser context but splits the work into independent, budgeted phases.\n * A phase that exhausts its budget is recorded BLOCKED without aborting later phases, so the\n * run no longer dies on a single cap. No real student data; fictional \"Learner QA\" only.\n *\n * Uses system chromium via playwright-core so no project dependency is added.\n */\nimport { chromium } from 'playwright-core';\nimport { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';\n\nconst base = process.env.AMINA_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';\nconst exe = process.env.CHROME_PATH || '/usr/bin/chromium';\nconst outDir = process.env.QA_OUT_DIR || 'artifacts/learner-flow';\nawait mkdir(outDir, { recursive: true });\n\nconst report = {\n  mission: 'Issue #9 R3 — learner-flow verification',\n  baseURL: base,\n  startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n  environment: 'local production build (dist + server.ts) on 127.0.0.1:4173; headless system chromium; /api/health hasApiKey=false (degraded AI routes)',\n  syntheticProfile: 'Learner QA (fictional)',\n  phases: [],\n  screens: [],\n  errors: [],\n};\n\nlet stepCount = 0;\nconst step = (label) => { stepCount += 1; return `${stepCount}. ${label}`; };\n\nasync function shot(page, name, viewport) {\n  const file = `${outDir}/${name}.png`;\n  await page.screenshot({ path: file, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});\n  const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({\n    dir: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).direction,\n    docWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,\n    vw: window.innerWidth,\n    nav: document.querySelectorAll('nav button').length,\n    text: (document.body.innerText || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 700),\n  }));\n  report.screens.push({ name, file, viewport, ...state });\n  return state;\n}\n\nasync function phase(id, title, budget, fn) {\n  const record = { id, title, budget, status: 'BLOCKED', steps: [], notes: [], evidence: [] };\n  report.phases.push(record);\n  const start = stepCount;\n  try {\n    await fn({\n      log: (m) => record.steps.push(step(m)),\n      note: (m) => record.notes.push(m),\n      evidence: (m) => record.evidence.push(m),\n      assertBudget: () => { if (stepCount - start >= budget) throw new Error(`PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED after ${budget} steps`); },\n    });\n    record.status = 'PASS';\n  } catch (e) {\n    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);\n    record.status = msg.startsWith('PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED') ? 'BLOCKED' : 'FAIL';\n    record.notes.push(`Error: ${msg.split('\\n')[0]}`);\n  }\n  return record;\n}\n\n/** Click a nav destination, dismissing any open modal overlay first. */\nasync function goTab(page, index) {\n  await page.keyboard.press('Escape').catch(() => {});\n  await page.waitForTimeout(200);\n  const close = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Close|Fermer|إغلاق|Go back|رجوع/i }).first();\n  if (await close.count().catch(() => 0)) {\n    await close.click({ timeout: 1500 }).catch(() => {});\n    await page.waitForTimeout(250);\n  }\n  await page.locator('nav button').nth(index).click({ timeout: 5000, force: true });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(500);\n}\n\n/** Reset the main scroll container to the top (snap feeds keep their own scroll offset). */\nasync function scrollTop(page) {\n  await page.evaluate(() => {\n    document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach((el) => {\n      const s = getComputedStyle(el);\n      if ((s.overflowY === 'auto' || s.overflowY === 'scroll') && el.scrollTop > 0) el.scrollTop = 0;\n    });\n  });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n}\n\nconst browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: exe, headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] });\nasync function newPage(ctx) {\n  const page = await ctx.newPage();\n  page.on('pageerror', (e) => report.errors.push({ type: 'pageerror', message: e.message }));\n  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') report.errors.push({ type: 'console', message: m.text().slice(0, 400) }); });\n  return page;\n}\n\nconst FINISH = { fr: 'Vérifier & Confirmer le Profil', ar: 'مراجعة وتأكيد الملف الشخصي', en: 'Review & Confirm Profile' };\nconst CONFIRM = { fr: 'Enregistrer & Commencer la Journée', ar: 'حفظ وبدء اليوم الدراسي', en: 'Save Profile & Start Day' };\nconst NAV_SKIP = /^(Back|Next Question|Submit|Retour|Question Suivante|Envoyer|رجوع|السؤال التالي|إرسال)/;\n\nasync function onboard(page, language) {\n  await page.goto(base, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().fill(language === 'ar' ? 'اختبار' : 'Learner QA');\n  const langBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: language === 'ar' ? /العربية/ : /Français/ }).first();\n  if (await langBtn.count()) await langBtn.click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(200);\n  await page.locator('button').last().click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {\n    const picked = await page.evaluate((skipSrc) => {\n      const skip = new RegExp(skipSrc);\n      const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter((b) => b.offsetWidth > 0);\n      const preset = btns.find((b) => {\n        const t = (b.innerText || '').trim();\n        return t && !skip.test(t) && !/🇪🇬|🇬🇧|🇫🇷/.test(t);\n      });\n      if (!preset) return null;\n      preset.click();\n      return preset.innerText.trim().slice(0, 40);\n    }, NAV_SKIP.source);\n    if (!picked) { const free = page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').last(); if (await free.count()) { await free.fill('Science'); await free.press('Enter'); } }\n    await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n  }\n  const finish = page.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(FINISH[language]) }).first();\n  if (await finish.count()) await finish.click();\n  else await page.locator('button').last().click(); // onboarding renders English copy even in French mode\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  const confirm = page.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(CONFIRM[language]) }).first();\n  if (await confirm.count()) await confirm.click();\n  else { const n = await page.locator('button').count(); await page.locator('button').nth(n - 2).click(); }\n  await page.locator('nav button').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 20000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n}\n\n/** Confirm today's school day so the FEED plan gate opens (FEED requires a confirmed day). */\nasync function confirmDay(page, language) {\n  const reportBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Report My Day|سجلي يومك|Signaler ma Journée/i }).first();\n  if (!(await reportBtn.count())) return { ok: false, why: 'HOME_STATE_A_ABSENT' };\n  await reportBtn.click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(700);\n  const sample = page.getByRole('button', { name: /We had Arabic|أخدنا عربي|On a eu arabe/i }).first();\n  if (await sample.count()) { await sample.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1800); }\n  else {\n    const bucket = page.locator('textarea, input[type=\"text\"]').first();\n    if (await bucket.count()) { await bucket.fill(language === 'ar' ? 'أخدنا عربي ورياضيات' : 'We had Arabic and Math'); }\n  }\n  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {\n    const confirm = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Yes, that is correct|نعم، هذا صحيح|Oui, c’est exact/i }).first();\n    if (await confirm.count()) { await confirm.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1200); break; }\n    const followNo = page.getByRole('button', { name: /No, remembered|لا افتكرت/i }).first();\n    if (await followNo.count()) { await followNo.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1200); continue; }\n    const skip = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Continue|متابعة|Continuer/i }).first();\n    if (await skip.count()) { await skip.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1000); }\n    break;\n  }\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  return { ok: true };\n}\n\n/** Pick a declared study time on HOME; this re-plans the day's missions. */\nasync function pickStudyTime(page, minutes = '45') {\n  const select = page.locator('select').first();\n  if (!(await select.count())) return false;\n  await select.selectOption(minutes).catch(() => {});\n  await page.waitForTimeout(1200);\n  return true;\n}\n\n/** Open a screen reachable only from the hamburger side menu (tab is not in the bottom nav). */\nasync function goMenuTab(page, label) {\n  await page.locator('button[aria-label=\"Menu\"]').first().click({ timeout: 5000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n  await page.locator('aside button').filter({ hasText: label }).first().click({ timeout: 5000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(700);\n}\n\nconst ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });\nconst page = await newPage(ctx);\n// The app derives \"after school\" from the real wall clock (>= 14:00) and offers no in-app\n// control to force it. p.evidence('00-home-after-onboarding.png');\n    if (st.nav !== 4) throw new Error(`expected 4 primary destinations, got ${st.nav}`);\n  });\n\n  await phase('S1', \"Plan today's study (declared study  "new_content": "/**\n * Amina learner-flow verification harness (Issue #9 / R3).\n *\n * Segmentation rationale: the earlier Forera synthetic-learner pass exhausted a hard 24-step\n * cap and stopped mid-onboarding (ADF-009: it clicked a disabled Submit with stale indexes).\n * This harness runs one browser context but splits the work into independent, budgeted phases.\n * A phase that exhausts its budget is recorded BLOCKED without aborting later phases, so the\n * run no longer dies on a single cap. No real student data; fictional \"Learner QA\" only.\n *\n * Uses system chromium via playwright-core so no project dependency is added.\n */\nimport { chromium } from 'playwright-core';\nimport { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';\n\nconst base = process.env.AMINA_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';\nconst exe = process.env.CHROME_PATH || '/usr/bin/chromium';\nconst outDir = process.env.QA_OUT_DIR || 'artifacts/learner-flow';\nawait mkdir(outDir, { recursive: true });\n\nconst report = {\n  mission: 'Issue #9 R3 — learner-flow verification',\n  baseURL: base,\n  startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n  environment: 'local production build (dist + server.ts) on 127.0.0.1:4173; headless system chromium; /api/health hasApiKey=false (degraded AI routes)',\n  syntheticProfile: 'Learner QA (fictional)',\n  phases: [],\n  screens: [],\n  errors: [],\n};\n\nlet stepCount = 0;\nconst step = (label) => { stepCount += 1; return `${stepCount}. ${label}`; };\n\nasync function shot(page, name, viewport) {\n  const file = `${outDir}/${name}.png`;\n  await page.screenshot({ path: file, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});\n  const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({\n    dir: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).direction,\n    docWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,\n    vw: window.innerWidth,\n    nav: document.querySelectorAll('nav button').length,\n    text: (document.body.innerText || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 700),\n  }));\n  report.screens.push({ name, file, viewport, ...state });\n  return state;\n}\n\nasync function phase(id, title, budget, fn) {\n  const record = { id, title, budget, status: 'BLOCKED', steps: [], notes: [], evidence: [] };\n  report.phases.push(record);\n  const start = stepCount;\n  try {\n    await fn({\n      log: (m) => record.steps.push(step(m)),\n      note: (m) => record.notes.push(m),\n      evidence: (m) => record.evidence.push(m),\n      assertBudget: () => { if (stepCount - start >= budget) throw new Error(`PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED after ${budget} steps`); },\n    });\n    record.status = 'PASS';\n  } catch (e) {\n    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);\n    record.status = msg.startsWith('PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED') ? 'BLOCKED' : 'FAIL';\n    record.notes.push(`Error: ${msg.split('\\n')[0]}`);\n  }\n  return record;\n}\n\n/** Click a nav destination, dismissing any open modal overlay first. */\nasync function goTab(page, index) {\n  await page.keyboard.press('Escape').catch(() => {});\n  await page.waitForTimeout(200);\n  const close = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Close|Fermer|إغلاق|Go back|رجوع/i }).first();\n  if (await close.count().catch(() => 0)) {\n    await close.click({ timeout: 1500 }).catch(() => {});\n    await page.waitForTimeout(250);\n  }\n  await page.locator('nav button').nth(index).click({ timeout: 5000, force: true });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(500);\n}\n\n/** Reset the main scroll container to the top (snap feeds keep their own scroll offset). */\nasync function scrollTop(page) {\n  await page.evaluate(() => {\n    document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach((el) => {\n      const s = getComputedStyle(el);\n      if ((s.overflowY === 'auto' || s.overflowY === 'scroll') && el.scrollTop > 0) el.scrollTop = 0;\n    });\n  });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n}\n\nconst browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: exe, headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] });\nasync function newPage(ctx) {\n  const page = await ctx.newPage();\n  page.on('pageerror', (e) => report.errors.push({ type: 'pageerror', message: e.message }));\n  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') report.errors.push({ type: 'console', message: m.text().slice(0, 400) }); });\n  return page;\n}\n\nconst FINISH = { fr: 'Vérifier & Confirmer le Profil', ar: 'مراجعة وتأكيد الملف الشخصي', en: 'Review & Confirm Profile' };\nconst CONFIRM = { fr: 'Enregistrer & Commencer la Journée', ar: 'حفظ وبدء اليوم الدراسي', en: 'Save Profile & Start Day' };\nconst NAV_SKIP = /^(Back|Next Question|Submit|Retour|Question Suivante|Envoyer|رجوع|السؤال التالي|إرسال)/;\n\nasync function onboard(page, language) {\n  await page.goto(base, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().fill(language === 'ar' ? 'اختبار' : 'Learner QA');\n  const langBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: language === 'ar' ? /العربية/ : /Français/ }).first();\n  if (await langBtn.count()) await langBtn.click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(200);\n  await page.locator('button').last().click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {\n    const picked = await page.evaluate((skipSrc) => {\n      const skip = new RegExp(skipSrc);\n      const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter((b) => b.offsetWidth > 0);\n      const preset = btns.find((b) => {\n        const t = (b.innerText || '').trim();\n        return t && !skip.test(t) && !/🇪🇬|🇬🇧|🇫🇷/.test(t);\n      });\n      if (!preset) return null;\n      preset.click();\n      return preset.innerText.trim().slice(0, 40);\n    }, NAV_SKIP.source);\n    if (!picked) { const free = page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').last(); if (await free.count()) { await free.fill('Science'); await free.press('Enter'); } }\n    await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n  }\n  const finish = page.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(FINISH[language]) }).first();\n  if (await finish.count()) await finish.click();\n  else await page.locator('button').last().click(); // onboarding renders English copy even in French mode\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  const confirm = page.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(CONFIRM[language]) }).first();\n  if (await confirm.count()) await confirm.click();\n  else { const n = await page.locator('button').count(); await page.locator('button').nth(n - 2).click(); }\n  await page.locator('nav button').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 20000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n}\n\n/** Confirm today's school day so the FEED plan gate opens (FEED requires a confirmed day). */\nasync function confirmDay(page, language) {\n  const reportBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Report My Day|سجلي يومك|Signaler ma Journée/i }).first();\n  if (!(await reportBtn.count())) return { ok: false, why: 'HOME_STATE_A_ABSENT' };\n  await reportBtn.click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(700);\n  const sample = page.getByRole('button', { name: /We had Arabic|أخدنا عربي|On a eu arabe/i }).first();\n  if (await sample.count()) { await sample.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1800); }\n  else {\n    const bucket = page.locator('textarea, input[type=\"text\"]').first();\n    if (await bucket.count()) { await bucket.fill(language === 'ar' ? 'أخدنا عربي ورياضيات' : 'We had Arabic and Math'); }\n  }\n  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {\n    const confirm = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Yes, that is correct|نعم، هذا صحيح|Oui, c’est exact/i }).first();\n    if (await confirm.count()) { await confirm.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1200); break; }\n    const followNo = page.getByRole('button', { name: /No, remembered|لا افتكرت/i }).first();\n    if (await followNo.count()) { await followNo.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1200); continue; }\n    const skip = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Continue|متابعة|Continuer/i }).first();\n    if (await skip.count()) { await skip.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1000); }\n    break;\n  }\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  return { ok: true };\n}\n\n/** Pick a declared study time on HOME; this re-plans the day's missions. */\nasync function pickStudyTime(page, minutes = '45') {\n  const select = page.locator('select').first();\n  if (!(await select.count())) return false;\n  await select.selectOption(minutes).catch(() => {});\n  await page.waitForTimeout(1200);\n  return true;\n}\n\n/** Open a screen reachable only from the hamburger side menu (tab is not in the bottom nav). */\nasync function goMenuTab(page, label) {\n  await page.locator('button[aria-label=\"Menu\"]').first().click({ timeout: 5000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n  await page.locator('aside button').filter({ hasText: label }).first().click({ timeout: 5000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(700);\n}\n\nconst ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });\nconst page = await newPage(ctx);\n// The app derives \"after school\" from the real wall clock (>= 14:00) and offers no in-app\n// control to force it. Pin the page clock to a post-school time so the intended learner flow\n// (report the school day -> plan -> FEED -> practice) is reachable and reproducible.\nconst AFTER_SCHOOL = new Date('2026-10-22T15:30:00');\nawait page.clock.setFixedTime(AFTER_SCHOOL);\n\ntry {\n  await phase('S0', 'Onboarding (French profile) completes and reaches HOME', 25, async (p) => {\n    await onboard(page, 'fr');\n    const st = await shot(page, '00-home-after-onboarding', '390x844');\n    p.log(`onboarding completed; dir=${st.dir}; nav=${st.nav}`);\n    p.evidence('00-home-after-onboarding.png');\n    if (st.nav !== 4) throw new Error(`expected 4 primary destinations, got ${st.nav}`);\n  });\n\n  await phase('S1', \"Plan today's study (declared study time re-plans missions)\", 10, async (p) => {\n    await goTab(page, 0);\n    const picked = await pickStudyTime(page, '45');\n    p.log(`study time selector used: ${picked}`);\n    const r = await p.evidence('01-home-after-planning.png');\n    p.note(`HOME after planning: ${st.text.slice(0, 300)}`);\n    const hasMissions = /Today's Mission Progress|Start This Mission|Start Homework|No missions next-action CTA present: ${hasCta}`);\n    p.note(`HOME text: ${st.text.slice(0, 260)}`);\n    p.evidence('T1-home.png');\n    if (!hasCta) throw new Error('HOME did not expose an obvious next action');\n  });\n\n  await phase('T2', 'Find a relevant curriculum lesson in LIBRARY', 6, async (p) => {\n    await goTab(page, 2);\n    const search = page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first();\n phase('T4', 'In FEED, complete a micro-lesson/quick check and read next action', 8, async (p) => {\n    await goTab(page, 1);\n    const st = await shot(page, 'T4-feed', '390x844');\n    p.log(`FEED page.evaluate(() => {\n      const c = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).filter((el) => {\n        const s = getComputedStyle(el);\n        return (s.overflowY === 'auto' || s.overflowY === found: true, before, after: t.scrollTop };\n    });\n    p.note(`FEED scroll: ${JSON.stringify(scrollState)}`);\n    p.evidence('T4-feed.png');\n    if (!scrollState.found || scrollState.after <= return { modalOpen, toast, savedCount: saved };\n    });\n    p.note(`after Save Item: ${JSON.stringify(diag)}`);\n    // Find it again in the dedicated Saved & Collections screen (menu-only tab).\n The overlay is `fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4`. Its rect should be 0-844 (inset-0). But it reports 397-697.

Ah — because the overlay is inside `DIV.relative.z-10.max-w-md` which has `pos=relative z=10` and rect 204-698. A `position: fixed` element's containing block is the viewport UNLESS an ancestor has a transform, filter, backdrop-filter, perspective, or `will-change`. 

Look at the ancestor chain: `DIV.rounded-[2rem].bg-white/10.backdrop-blur-xl pos=static z=auto rect=396-698`. That has `backdrop-blur-xl` = `backdrop-filter: blur(24px)`. **`backdrop-filter` creates a containing block for fixed-position descendants!**

So the Save-to-Collection modal — which is `position: fixed; inset: 0` intending to cover the whole viewport — is instead confined to the bounding box of its `backdrop-blur-xl` ancestor section. That ancestor is the FEED snap section, rect 396-698 (height ~302px). The modal card is `max-h-[90vh]` = 759px tall, which overflows that 302px containing block, so the modal's footer (Save Item button at 761-789) renders BELOW the containing block's bottom edge (698) and gets painted under the bottom nav (z-40, rect 774-844) — no wait, nav z-40 < overlay z-50. Content overflowing the overlay (the card 292-802) would be visible (no overflow hidden) but the overlay's own background only covers 397-697. The card is `overflow-hidden` on the card div... the card is 292-802 and has the footer button at 761-789.

Unless the card's `max-h-[90vh] overflow-hidden` clips it: card rect is 292-802 (height 510)? But max-h 90vh = 759. Hmm, the card reports 292-802 = 510px height. And the button is at 761-789 which is OUTSIDE the card (802 bottom? no, 789 < 802). 

Hmm, 761-789 is within 292-802. So the button IS inside the card rect. But hit test says NAV. That means the button, though within the card's box, is not painted there... 

Actually wait. The card's parent (overlay) is 397-697. The card is taller than the overlay and centered: card 292-802 vs overlay 397-697. If the overlay is `flex items-center justify-center`, the card is centered in 397-697 → card center = 547, card height 510 → 292-802. Yes.

But the overlay itself (z-50, fixed) is only 397-697 tall. The card overflows the overlay. Since the overlay has no `overflow: hidden`, the card's overflow paints. But does the card's overflow paint above the nav? Stacking: overlay z-50 in the root stacking context. Nav z-40 in... the nav is `sticky bottom-0 z-40`. Both in the same stacking context (root), so z-50 overlay paints above z-40 nav — including its overflowing card content. So the button SHOULD be hit-testable.

Unless... the overlay's containing block being the backdrop-filter ancestor changes things. When `backdrop-filter` creates a containing block, it ALSO creates a stacking context. So the overlay z-50 is scoped inside the `DIV.rounded-[2rem].bg-white/10.backdrop-blur-xl` stacking context (z=auto, so it's in the normal flow of its parent stacking context). The nav is z-40 in the root stacking context. The backdrop-blur ancestor has z=auto → it does NOT establish a stacking context by z-index, but backdrop-filter DOES establish a stacking context. The PR #13 harness's task 5 used `colBtn` filter with `Favorites|Révisions|Watching|Favourites|قائمة` — none of which match the actual collection names (Arabic, Mathematics, Before Exam, I Don't Understand, Important, Review Later). But my debug proved: when a collection IS selected (Arabic), and the Save Item button is clicked via DOM `.click()`, the item persists AND appears in Saved & Collections. When clicked via pointer at its center, the click is intercepted by the bottom nav because of the CSS containing-block bug.

Wait — in PR13's harness they used `await confirm.click()` (pointer). So the pointer click would be intercepted. Hence 0 saves. So their F-01 ("saved to no collection") is a MISDIAGNOSIS of the actual root cause.

Hold on. Let me re-check my dbg-t5b run: pointer click → savedCount 0, modal still open. DOM click → savedCount 1, modal closed. And the geometry test showed the button's center (279, 775) hits NAV.

Actually the difference: in debug-save.mjs I clicked the modal's `div.grid button` chip via `page.locator('div.grid button').filter({hasText:'Arabic'})`. Then `page.getByRole('button',{name:/Save Item/}).first().click()` — pointer click worked.

Hmm, so pointer click worked there but not in dbg-t5b. Difference: in debug-save.mjs the daily day-report was NOT done (missions empty), so FEED content differed — the feed card layout and modal height differed. In dbg-t5b, the day was reported and missions existed, so the modal was taller (299px card) and extended lower, overlapping nav.

Actually the modal is `fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center` — it should be centered in the viewport. But it's positioned relative to the transformed/containing-block ancestor, which is the scrollable feed container with height `calc(100vh-64px)`, and its content is scrolled. When the feed is scrolled to a card, the containing block's position shifts, pushing the modal down so its footer lands under the bottom nav.

In debug-save.mjs I did NOT scroll the feed, so the modal's containing block was at scrollTop 0 → modal centered in the container → footer at ~y=696, above nav at 774. So the pointer click worked.

In dbg-t5b/dbg-t5e, I called `scrollTop(page)` first (scroll reset to 0)... hmm, but then the modal was at 397-697 which is ABOVE nav 774. Yet the button rect was 761-789, which is BELOW the modal card's 397-697. That's the inconsistency: `getBoundingClientRect` of the button says 761-789 while its ancestor `.fixed` says 397-697. A child cannot be outside its parent unless the parent has `position: fixed` and the child... 

Actually that IS possible: if the ancestor `.fixed` is NOT the containing block (because a nearer ancestor has a transform/filter/backdrop-filter), then... no, `getBoundingClientRect` is absolute; a child inside a parent must be within the parent's border box unless the child itself is positioned absolutely relative to a different containing block.

Hmm — the button's parent chain: BUTTON (static) → DIV.p-3.border-t (static, 748-801) → DIV.bg-white... (static, 292-802) → DIV.fixed.inset-0.z-50 (fixed, 397-697). The card (292-802) is 510px tall but the `.fixed` parent is 397-697 (300px). So the CARD overflows its own `.fixed` parent by 210px. That means the `.fixed` parent is NOT the containing block for the card's layout... 

The `.fixed` element has `backdrop-blur-xs` = `backdrop-filter: blur(2px)`. **An element with backdrop-filter creates a containing block for its fixed/absolute descendants — but it also creates a stacking context.** More importantly, the `.fixed` element's own `getBoundingClientRect` (397-697) is computed... 

Hmm, actually: the `.fixed.inset-0` has `inset: 0` relative to its containing block. Its containing block is the nearest ancestor with transform/filter/backdrop-filter — the feed card `<div class="rounded-[2rem] bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl">` (rect 396-698 in the chain). So `.fixed.inset-0` = 396-698. Correct.

Then the modal card `<div class="bg-white ... max-h-[90vh]">` is a flex child, centered → 292-802? That's 510px, centered on 396-698 (center 547) would be 292-802. Yes! It's centered within the 300px-tall `.fixed` container, so it OVERFLOWS above and below the container (292 < 396, 802 > 698). Because `max-h-[90vh]` = 760px and the content is 510px, the flex centering overflows the container.

So the footer (748-801) extends BELOW the containing block (698) and lands at 748-801 — under the nav (774-844). The nav has z-index 40, modal 50, but they're in different stacking contexts: the modal's `.fixed` is nested inside the feed's `backdrop-blur-xl` card (a new stacking context with z-index auto but stacking due to filter), so the modal's z-50 only applies WITHIN that card's stacking context. The nav (z-40) is a sibling in the root stacking context, painted above the card's whole subtree.

That's the definitive root cause: **`SaveToCollectionModal` renders inside the FEED card subtree; the card has `backdrop-blur-xl` which creates a stacking context, trapping the modal's `z-50` below the bottom nav's `z-40`. Combined with `max-h-[90vh]` overflow centering, the modal footer lands under the nav and its clicks are intercepted.**

false;\n    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i += 1) {\n      const opt = page.locator('main button, [role=\"dialog\"] button')\n        .filter({ hasNotText: /Close|Back|Go back|رجوع|إغلاق|Skip|تخطي/i }).nth(i + 1);\n      if (!(await opt.count())) break;\n      await opt.click({ force: true }).catch(() => {});\n      await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n      st = await shot(page, `T6-answer-${i}`, '390x844');\n      if (/correct|incorrect|try again|feedback|explain differently|hint|حاول|خطأ|صحيح|أعد|réessa|indice/i.test(st.text)) {\n        sawFeedback = true;\n fetch(`${b}/api/health`)).json(), base);\n    p.note(`/api/health = ${JSON.stringify(health)}`);\n    const st = await shot(page, 'T7-degraded-state', '390x844');\n    p.log('captured degraded (no-API-key) state');\n    p.evidence('T7-degraded-state.png');\n    p.note(`visible text: ${st.text.slice(0, 200)}`);\n  });\n\n  await phase('T8', 'Desktop 1365px and Arabic RTL render without overflow', 30, async (p) => {\n    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1365, height: 900 });\n    await goTab(page, 0);\n    const d = await shot(page, 'T8-home-desktop-1365', '1365x900');\n    p.log(`desktop HOME docWidth=${d.docWidth} viewport=${d.vw}`);\n    p.evidence('T8-home-desktop-1365.png');\n    const rtlCtx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, (fatal) {\n  report.fatalError = fatal instanceof Error ? fatal.stack || fatal.message : String(fatal);\n} finally {\n  await browser.close().catch(() => {});\n  report.totalSteps = stepCount;\n  report.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n  const summary = report.phases.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, status: p.status, title: p.title }));\n  const failed = report.phases.filter((p) => p.status !==  "new_content": "/**\n * Amina learner-flow verification harness (Issue #9 / R3).\n *\n * Segmentation rationale: the earlier Forera synthetic-learner pass exhausted a hard 24-step\n * cap and stopped mid-onboarding (ADF-009: it clicked a disabled Submit with stale indexes).\n * This harness runs one browser context but splits the work into independent, budgeted phases.\n * A phase that exhausts its budget is recorded BLOCKED without aborting later phases, so the\n * run no longer dies on a single cap. No real student data; fictional \"Learner QA\" only.\n *\n * Uses system chromium via playwright-core so no project dependency is added.\n */\nimport { chromium } from 'playwright-core';\nimport { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';\n\nconst base = process.env.AMINA_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';\nconst exe = process.env.CHROME_PATH || '/usr/bin/chromium';\nconst outDir = process.env.QA_OUT_DIR || 'artifacts/learner-flow';\nawait mkdir(outDir, { recursive: true });\n\nconst report = {\n  mission: 'Issue #9 R3 — learner-flow verification',\n  baseURL: base,\n  startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n  environment: 'local production build (dist + server.ts) on 127.0.0.1:4173; headless system chromium; /api/health hasApiKey=false (degraded AI routes)',\n  syntheticProfile: 'Learner QA (fictional)',\n  phases: [],\n  screens: [],\n  errors: [],\n};\n\nlet stepCount = 0;\nconst step = (label) => { stepCount += 1; return `${stepCount}. ${label}`; };\n\nasync function shot(page, name, viewport) {\n  const file = `${outDir}/${name}.png`;\n  await page.screenshot({ path: file, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});\n  const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({\n    dir: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).direction,\n    docWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,\n    vw: window.innerWidth,\n    nav: document.querySelectorAll('nav button').length,\n    text: (document.body.innerText || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 700),\n  }));\n  report.screens.push({ name, file, viewport, ...state });\n  return state;\n}\n\nasync function phase(id, title, budget, fn) {\n  const record = { id, title, budget, status: 'BLOCKED', steps: [], notes: [], evidence: [] };\n  report.phases.push(record);\n  const start = stepCount;\n  try {\n    await fn({\n      log: (m) => record.steps.push(step(m)),\n      note: (m) => record.notes.push(m),\n      evidence: (m) => record.evidence.push(m),\n      assertBudget: () => { if (stepCount - start >= budget) throw new Error(`PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED after ${budget} steps`); },\n    });\n    record.status = 'PASS';\n  } catch (e) {\n    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);\n    record.status = msg.startsWith('PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED') ? 'BLOCKED' : 'FAIL';\n    record.notes.push(`Error: ${msg.split('\\n')[0]}`);\n  }\n  return record;\n}\n\n/** Click a nav destination, dismissing any open modal overlay first. */\nasync function goTab(page, index) {\n  await page.keyboard.press('Escape').catch(() => {});\n  await page.waitForTimeout(200);\n  const close = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Close|Fermer|إغلاق|Go back|رجوع/i }).first();\n  if (await close.count().catch(() => 0)) {\n    await close.click({ timeout: 1500 }).catch(() => {});\n    await page.waitForTimeout(250);\n  }\n  await page.locator('nav button').nth(index).click({ timeout: 5000, force: true });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(500);\n}\n\n/** Reset the main scroll container to the top (snap feeds keep their own scroll offset). */\nasync function scrollTop(page) {\n  await page.evaluate(() => {\n    document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach((el) => {\n      const s = getComputedStyle(el);\n      if ((s.overflowY === 'auto' || s.overflowY === 'scroll') && el.scrollTop > 0) el.scrollTop = 0;\n    });\n  });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n}\n\nconst browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: exe, headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] });\nasync function newPage(ctx) {\n  const page = await ctx.newPage();\n  page.on('pageerror', (e) => report.errors.push({ type: 'pageerror', message: e.message }));\n  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') report.errors.push({ type: 'console', message: m.text().slice(0, 400) }); });\n  return page;\n}\n\nconst FINISH = { fr: 'Vérifier & Confirmer le Profil', ar: 'مراجعة وتأكيد الملف الشخصي', en: 'Review & Confirm Profile' };\nconst CONFIRM = { fr: 'Enregistrer & Commencer la Journée', ar: 'حفظ وبدء اليوم الدراسي', en: 'Save Profile & Start Day' };\nconst NAV_SKIP = /^(Back|Next Question|Submit|Retour|Question Suivante|Envoyer|رجوع|السؤال التالي|إرسال)/;\n\nasync function onboard(page, language) {\n  await page.goto(base, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().fill(language === 'ar' ? 'اختبار' : 'Learner QA');\n  const langBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: language === 'ar' ? /العربية/ : /Français/ }).first();\n  if (await langBtn.count()) await langBtn.click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(200);\n  await page.locator('button').last().click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {\n    const picked = await page.evaluate((skipSrc) => {\n      const skip = new RegExp(skipSrc);\n      const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter((b) => b.offsetWidth > 0);\n      const preset = btns.find((b) => {\n        const t = (b.innerText || '').trim();\n        return t && !skip.test(t) && !/🇪🇬|🇬🇧|🇫🇷/.test(t);\n      });\n      if (!preset) return null;\n      preset.click();\n      return preset.innerText.trim().slice(0, 40);\n    }, NAV_SKIP.source);\n    if (!picked) { const free = page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').last(); if (await free.count()) { await free.fill('Science'); await free.press('Enter'); } }\n    await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n  }\n  const finish = page.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(FINISH[language]) }).first();\n  if (await finish.count()) await finish.click();\n  else await page.locator('button').last().click(); // onboarding renders English copy even in French mode\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  const confirm = page.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(CONFIRM[language]) }).first();\n  if (await confirm.count()) await confirm.click();\n  else { const n = await page.locator('button').count(); await page.locator('button').nth(n - 2).click(); }\n  await page.locator('nav button').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 20000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n}\n\n/** Confirm today's school day so the FEED plan gate opens (FEED requires a confirmed day). */\nasync function confirmDay(page, language) {\n  const reportBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Report My Day|سجلي يومك|Signaler ma Journée/i }).first();\n  if (!(await reportBtn.count())) return { ok: false, why: 'HOME_STATE_A_ABSENT' };\n  await reportBtn.click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(700);\n  const sample = page.getByRole('button', { name: /We had Arabic|أخدنا عربي|On a eu arabe/i }).first();\n  if (await sample.count()) { await sample.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1800); }\n  else {\n    const bucket = page.locator('textarea, input[type=\"text\"]').first();\n    if (await bucket.count()) { await bucket.fill(language === 'ar' ? 'أخدنا عربي ورياضيات' : 'We had Arabic and Math'); }\n  }\n  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {\n    const confirm = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Yes, that is correct|نعم، هذا صحيح|Oui, c’est exact/i }).first();\n    if (await confirm.count()) { await confirm.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1200); break; }\n    const followNo = page.getByRole('button', { name: /No, remembered|لا افتكرت/i }).first();\n    if (await followNo.count()) { await followNo.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1200); continue; }\n    const skip = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Continue|متابعة|Continuer/i }).first();\n    if (await skip.count()) { await skip.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1000); }\n    break;\n  }\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  return { ok: true };\n}\n\n/** Pick a declared study time on HOME; this re-plans the day's missions. */\nasync function pickStudyTime(page, minutes = '45') {\n  const select = page.locator('select').first();\n  if (!(await select.count())) return false;\n  await select.selectOption(minutes).catch(() => {});\n  await page.waitForTimeout(1200);\n  return true;\n}\n\n/** Open a screen reachable only from the hamburger side menu (tab is not in the bottom nav). */\nasync function goMenuTab(page, label) {\n  await page.locator('button[aria-label=\"Menu\"]').first().click({ timeout: 5000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n  await page.locator('aside button').filter({ hasText: label }).first().click({ timeout: 5000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(700);\n}\n\nconst ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });\nconst page = await newPage(ctx);\n// The app derives \"after school\" from the real wall clock (>= 14:00) and offers no in-app\n// control to force it. Pin the page clock to a post-school time so the intended learner flow\n// (report the school day -> plan -> FEED -> practice) is reachable and reproducible.\nconst AFTER_SCHOOL = new Date('2026-10-22T15:30:00');\nawait page.clock.setFixedTime(AFTER_SCHOOL);\n\ntry {\n  await phase('S0', 'Onboarding (French profile) completes and reaches HOME', 25, async (p) => {\n    await onboard(page, 'fr');\n    const st = await shot(page, '00-home-after-onboarding', '390x844');\n    p.log(`onboarding completed; dir=${st.dir}; nav=${st.nav}`);\n    p.evidence('00-home-after-onboarding.png');\n    if (st.nav !== 4) throw new Error(`expected 4 primary destinations, got ${st.nav}`);\n  });\n\n  await phase('S1', \"Plan today's study (declared study time re-plans missions)\", 10, async (p) => {\n    await goTab(page, 0);\n    const picked = await pickStudyTime(page, '45');\n    p.log(`study time selector used: ${picked}`);\n    const r = await confirmDay(page, 'fr');\n    p.note(`day-record CTA result: ${JSON.stringify(r)}`);\n    const st = await shot(page, '01-home-after-planning', '390x844');\n    p.evidence('01-home-after-planning.png');\n    p.note(`HOME after planning: ${st.text.slice(0, 300)}`);\n    const hasMissions = /Today's Mission Progress|Start This Mission|Start Homework|No missions planned yet/i.test(st.text);\n    if (!hasMissions) throw new Error('HOME mission surface did not render after planning');\n    if (!r.ok) p.note(`day-record flow not offered at this time-of-day (${r.why}); declared-time planning used instead`);\n  });\n\n  await phase('T1', 'From HOME, determine what to do next today and start it', 6, async (p) => {\n    await goTab(page, 0);\n    const st = await shot(page, 'T1-home', '390x844');\n    const hasCta = /Report My Day|Start This Mission|Open Calm Daily Review|سجلي يومك|ابدئي هذه المهمة|Signaler ma Journée/i.test(st.text);\n    p.log(`HOME next-action CTA present: ${hasCta}`);\n    p.note(`HOME text: ${st.text.slice(0, 260)}`);\n    p.evidence('T1-home.png');\n    if (!hasCta) throw new Error('HOME did not expose an obvious next action');\n  });\n\n  await phase('T2', 'Find a relevant curriculum lesson in LIBRARY', 6, async (p) => {\n    await goTab(page, 2);\n    const search = page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first();\n    p.assertBudget();\n    const ph = (await search.getAttribute('placeholder')) || '';\n    p.note(`LIBRARY search placeholder: \"${ph}\"`);\n    await search.fill('Mathématiques');\n    await phase('T3', 'Start the selected lesson with NOUR (context carries in)', 8, async (p) => {\n    const startBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Learn with Nour|اتعلمي مع نور|Nour|Study|Learn|ابدأ/i }).first();\n    p.assertBudget();\n    if (await startBtn.count()) { await startBtn.click(); p.log('clicked a lesson start / Nour action'); }\n    else throw new Error('no lesson start affordance found in LIBRARY');\n    await page.waitForTimeout(1100);\n    const st = await shot(page, 'T3-nour-session', '390x844');\n    p.log(`NOUR/lesson surface: ${st.text.slice(0, 200)}`);\n    p.evidence('T3-nour-session.png');\n    if (!/Nour|نور/i.test(st.text) && !/lesson|Leçon|درس/i.test(st.text)) throw new Error('lesson/Nour surface did not carry visible context');\n  });\n\n  await phase('T4', 'In FEED, complete a micro-lesson/quick check and read next action', 8, async (p) => {\n    await goTab(page, 1);\n    const st = await shot(page, 'T4-feed', '390x844');\n    p.log(`FEED page.evaluate(() => {\n      const c = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).filter((el) => {\n        const s = getComputedStyle(el);\n        return (s.overflowY === 'auto' || s.overflowY === 'scroll') && el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 20 && el.clientHeight > 300;\n      });\n      const t = c.sort((a, b) => b.clientHeight - a.clientHeight)[0];\n      if (!t) return { found: false };\n      const before = t.scrollTop;\n      t.scrollTop = Math.min(t.scrollHeight, before + t.clientHeight * 0.95);\n      t.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll', { bubbles: true }));\n      return { ${st.text.slice(0, 200)}`);\n    p.evidence('T5-save-modal.png');\n    // Select a collection chip, then commit the save.\n    const chip = page.locator('button').filter({ hasText: chip.innerText()).trim()}`); await page.waitForTimeout(300); }\n    const saveItem = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Save Item|Enregistrer|احفظ/i }).last();\n    if (await saveItem.count()) { await p.log(`mission surface: ${st.text.slice(0, 220)}`);\n    p.evidence('T6-mission-open.png');\n    // Answer a quiz item, deliberately choosing options until feedback/adaptation appears.\n    let back|رجوع|إغلاق|Skip|تخطي/i }).nth(i + 1);\n      if (!(await opt.count())) break;\n      await opt.click({ force: true }).catch(() => {});\n      await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n      st = await p.log(`desktop HOME docWidth=${d.docWidth} viewport=${d.vw}`);\n    p.evidence('T8-home-desktop-1365.png');\n    const rtlCtx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 },  "new_content": "/**\n * Amina learner-flow verification harness (Issue #9 / R3).\n *\n * Segmentation rationale: the earlier Forera synthetic-learner pass exhausted a hard 24-step\n * cap and stopped mid-onboarding (ADF-009: it clicked a disabled Submit with stale indexes).\n * This harness runs one browser context but splits the work into independent, budgeted phases.\n * A phase that exhausts its budget is recorded BLOCKED without aborting later phases, so the\n * run no longer dies on a single cap. No real student data; fictional \"Learner QA\" only.\n *\n * Uses system chromium via playwright-core so no project dependency is added.\n */\nimport { chromium } from 'playwright-core';\nimport { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';\n\nconst base = process.env.AMINA_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';\nconst exe = process.env.CHROME_PATH || '/usr/bin/chromium';\nconst outDir = process.env.QA_OUT_DIR || 'artifacts/learner-flow';\nawait mkdir(outDir, { recursive: true });\n\nconst report = {\n  mission: 'Issue #9 R3 — learner-flow verification',\n  baseURL: base,\n  startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n  environment: 'local production build (dist + server.ts) on 127.0.0.1:4173; headless system chromium; /api/health hasApiKey=false (degraded AI routes)',\n  syntheticProfile: 'Learner QA (fictional)',\n  phases: [],\n  screens: [],\n  errors: [],\n};\n\nlet stepCount = 0;\nconst step = (label) => { stepCount += 1; return `${stepCount}. ${label}`; };\n\nasync function shot(page, name, viewport) {\n  const file = `${outDir}/${name}.png`;\n  await page.screenshot({ path: file, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});\n  const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({\n    dir: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).direction,\n    docWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,\n    vw: window.innerWidth,\n    nav: document.querySelectorAll('nav button').length,\n    text: (document.body.innerText || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 700),\n  }));\n  report.screens.push({ name, file, viewport, ...state });\n  return state;\n}\n\nasync function phase(id, title, budget, fn) {\n  const record = { id, title, budget, status: 'BLOCKED', steps: [], notes: [], evidence: [] };\n  report.phases.push(record);\n  const start = stepCount;\n  try {\n    await fn({\n      log: (m) => record.steps.push(step(m)),\n      note: (m) => record.notes.push(m),\n      evidence: (m) => record.evidence.push(m),\n      assertBudget: () => { if (stepCount - start >= budget) throw new Error(`PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED after ${budget} steps`); },\n    });\n    record.status = 'PASS';\n  } catch (e) {\n    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);\n    record.status = msg.startsWith('PHASE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED') ? 'BLOCKED' : 'FAIL';\n    record.notes.push(`Error: ${msg.split('\\n')[0]}`);\n  }\n  return record;\n}\n\n/** Click a nav destination, dismissing any open modal overlay first. */\nasync function goTab(page, index) {\n  await page.keyboard.press('Escape').catch(() => {});\n  await page.waitForTimeout(200);\n  const close = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Close|Fermer|إغلاق|Go back|رجوع/i }).first();\n  if (await close.count().catch(() => 0)) {\n    await close.click({ timeout: 1500 }).catch(() => {});\n    await page.waitForTimeout(250);\n  }\n  await page.locator('nav button').nth(index).click({ timeout: 5000, force: true });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(500);\n}\n\n/** Reset the main scroll container to the top (snap feeds keep their own scroll offset). */\nasync function scrollTop(page) {\n  await page.evaluate(() => {\n    document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach((el) => {\n      const s = getComputedStyle(el);\n      if ((s.overflowY === 'auto' || s.overflowY === 'scroll') && el.scrollTop > 0) el.scrollTop = 0;\n    });\n  });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n}\n\nconst browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: exe, headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] });\nasync function newPage(ctx) {\n  const page = await ctx.newPage();\n  page.on('pageerror', (e) => report.errors.push({ type: 'pageerror', message: e.message }));\n  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') report.errors.push({ type: 'console', message: m.text().slice(0, 400) }); });\n  return page;\n}\n\nconst FINISH = { fr: 'Vérifier & Confirmer le Profil', ar: 'مراجعة وتأكيد الملف الشخصي', en: 'Review & Confirm Profile' };\nconst CONFIRM = { fr: 'Enregistrer & Commencer la Journée', ar: 'حفظ وبدء اليوم الدراسي', en: 'Save Profile & Start Day' };\nconst NAV_SKIP = /^(Back|Next Question|Submit|Retour|Question Suivante|Envoyer|رجوع|السؤال التالي|إرسال)/;\n\nasync function onboard(page, language) {\n  await page.goto(base, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().fill(language === 'ar' ? 'اختبار' : 'Learner QA');\n  const langBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: language === 'ar' ? /العربية/ : /Français/ }).first();\n  if (await langBtn.count()) await langBtn.click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(200);\n  await page.locator('button').last().click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {\n    const picked = await page.evaluate((skipSrc) => {\n      const skip = new RegExp(skipSrc);\n      const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter((b) => b.offsetWidth > 0);\n      const preset = btns.find((b) => {\n        const t = (b.innerText || '').trim();\n        return t && !skip.test(t) && !/🇪🇬|🇬🇧|🇫🇷/.test(t);\n      });\n      if (!preset) return null;\n      preset.click();\n      return preset.innerText.trim().slice(0, 40);\n    }, NAV_SKIP.source);\n    if (!picked) { const free = page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').last(); if (await free.count()) { await free.fill('Science'); await free.press('Enter'); } }\n    await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n  }\n  const finish = page.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(FINISH[language]) }).first();\n  if (await finish.count()) await finish.click();\n  else await page.locator('button').last().click(); // onboarding renders English copy even in French mode\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  const confirm = page.getByRole('button', { name: new RegExp(CONFIRM[language]) }).first();\n  if (await confirm.count()) await confirm.click();\n  else { const n = await page.locator('button').count(); await page.locator('button').nth(n - 2).click(); }\n  await page.locator('nav button').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 20000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n}\n\n/** Confirm today's school day so the FEED plan gate opens (FEED requires a confirmed day). */\nasync function confirmDay(page, language) {\n  const reportBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Report My Day|سجلي يومك|Signaler ma Journée/i }).first();\n  if (!(await reportBtn.count())) return { ok: false, why: 'HOME_STATE_A_ABSENT' };\n  await reportBtn.click();\n  await page.waitForTimeout(700);\n  const sample = page.getByRole('button', { name: /We had Arabic|أخدنا عربي|On a eu arabe/i }).first();\n  if (await sample.count()) { await sample.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1800); }\n  else {\n    const bucket = page.locator('textarea, input[type=\"text\"]').first();\n    if (await bucket.count()) { await bucket.fill(language === 'ar' ? 'أخدنا عربي ورياضيات' : 'We had Arabic and Math'); }\n  }\n  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {\n    const confirm = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Yes, that is correct|نعم، هذا صحيح|Oui, c’est exact/i }).first();\n    if (await confirm.count()) { await confirm.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1200); break; }\n    const followNo = page.getByRole('button', { name: /No, remembered|لا افتكرت/i }).first();\n    if (await followNo.count()) { await followNo.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1200); continue; }\n    const skip = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Continue|متابعة|Continuer/i }).first();\n    if (await skip.count()) { await skip.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1000); }\n    break;\n  }\n  await page.waitForTimeout(600);\n  return { ok: true };\n}\n\n/** Pick a declared study time on HOME; this re-plans the day's missions. */\nasync function pickStudyTime(page, minutes = '45') {\n  const select = page.locator('select').first();\n  if (!(await select.count())) return false;\n  await select.selectOption(minutes).catch(() => {});\n  await page.waitForTimeout(1200);\n  return true;\n}\n\n/** Open a screen reachable only from the hamburger side menu (tab is not in the bottom nav). */\nasync function goMenuTab(page, label) {\n  await page.locator('button[aria-label=\"Menu\"]').first().click({ timeout: 5000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(400);\n  await page.locator('aside button').filter({ hasText: label }).first().click({ timeout: 5000 });\n  await page.waitForTimeout(700);\n}\n\nconst ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });\nconst page = await newPage(ctx);\n// The app derives \"after school\" from the real wall clock (>= 14:00) and offers no in-app\n// control to force it. Pin the page clock to a post-school time so the intended learner flow\n// (report the school day -> plan -> FEED -> practice) is reachable and reproducible.\nconst AFTER_SCHOOL = new Date('2026-10-22T15:30:00');\nawait page.clock.setFixedTime(AFTER_SCHOOL);\n\ntry {\n  await phase('S0', 'Onboarding (French profile) completes and reaches HOME', 25, async (p) => {\n    await onboard(page, 'fr');\n    const st = await shot(page, '00-home-after-onboarding', '390x844');\n    p.log(`onboarding completed; dir=${st.dir}; nav=${st.nav}`);\n    p.evidence('00-home-after-onboarding.png');\n    if (st.nav !== 4) throw new Error(`expected 4 primary destinations, got ${st.nav}`);\n  });\n\n  await phase('S1', \"Plan today's study (declared study confirmDay(page, 'fr');\n    p.note(`day-record CTA result: ${JSON.stringify(r)}`);\n    const st = await shot(page, '01-home-after-planning', '390x844');\n    p.evidence('01-home-after-planning.png');\n    p.note(`HOME after planning: ${st.text.slice(0, 300)}`);\n    const hasMissions = /Today's Mission Progress|Start This Mission|Start Homework|No missions next-action CTA present: ${hasCta}`);\n    p.note(`HOME text: ${st.text.slice(0, 260)}`);\n    p.evidence('T1-home.png');\n    if (!hasCta) throw new Error('HOME did not expose an obvious next p.evidence('T3-nour-session.png');\n    if (!/Nour|نور/i.test(st.text) && !/lesson|Leçon|درس/i.test(st.text)) throw new Error('lesson/Nour surface did not carry visible context');\n  });\n\n  await phase('T4', 'In FEED, complete a micro-lesson/quick check and read next action', 8, async (p) => {\n    await goTab(page, 1);\n    const st = await shot(page, 'T4-feed', '390x844');\n    p.log(`FEED page.evaluate(() => {\n      const c = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).filter((el) => {\n        const s = getComputedStyle(el);\n        return (s.overflowY === 'auto' || s.overflowY === };\n      const before = t.scrollTop;\n      t.scrollTop = Math.min(t.scrollHeight, before + t.clientHeight * 0.95);\n      t.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll', { bubbles: true }));\n      return { chip.innerText()).trim()}`); await page.waitForTimeout(300); }\n    await shot(page, 'T5-save-modal-footer', '390x844');\n    p.evidence('T5-save-modal-footer.png');\n    const saveItem = - With Arabic selected: button `disabled: false`, but hit-test at button centre → `NAV` (still occluded, isBtn:false).
- Yet `getByRole('button').click()` (Playwright, which scrolls into view and clicks the actual element) succeeded → saved_items 0 → 1.

Wait — Playwright's click succeeded despite the hit test showing NAV? Playwright checks hit target and retries; with auto-scroll and actionability it may scroll the modal card so the button is not under the nav. Actually Playwright scrolls the element into view — the modal body is scrollable (`overflow-y-auto`), so Playwright scrolled the button up, out from under the nav, then clicked. That's why it worked.

So Playwright's actionability auto-scroll masks the defect. A real user (touch/pointer, no auto-scroll) would tap the nav.

So the defect: at 390×844 the modal footer button's centre is under the bottom nav (which paints on top due to the ancestor backdrop-blur stacking context). The `disabled:true` state on PR15 partially mitigates: with nothing selected the button is disabled (so a stray tap on nav does nothing to save anyway) — but that's coincidental; the disabled button is still visually occluded, and once a collection IS selected the button is enabled but still under the nav.

{
 "command": "create",
 "path": "/tmp/auditwt/docs/audits/AMINA_AUDIT_ADDENDUM_MODAL_OCCLUSION_2026-10-22.md",
 "file_text": "# Amina / Miss Nour — audit addendum: modal occlusion defeats the Save fix (F-08)\n\n**Date:** 2026-10-22\n**Auditor:** OpenHands (authorized repository coding/auditing executor per issue #9)\n**Baseline for new findings:** `main` @ `86c1e73cf760069b1dd58fba994f3f3f0f49a00c`\n**Companion report:** `docs/audits/AMINA_FORENSIC_AUDIT_2026-10-22.md` (R1/R3)\n**Scope:** read-only investigation of the save/revisit loop, reproduced against a real production build. No production change, no merge, no deployment.\n\n> Status labels used below: **Verified** (reproduced with the recorded output/artifact), **Observed-not-verified**, **Hypothesis**, **Blocked**.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Why this addendum exists\n\nThe companion report's F-01 described a logic defect: the Save-to-Collection sheet allowed a save with no collection ticked, so the item was filed nowhere while a \"Saved to collection\" toast still appeared.\n\nThat logic defect is now addressed on **PR #15** (`fix/save-item-without-collection`, head `ec4f48ef74`), which disables **Save Item** until at least one collection is selected. Independently re-checked here: the guard is present, `npm run test:integrity` is 69/69, and a save that names a collection is discoverable in it.\n\nThis addendum records a **second, independent defect in the same flow** that the PR #15 guard does **not** fix, and that the PR's own test cannot detect, because the test calls the service directly and never clicks the button in a browser.\n\n---\n\n## 2. F-08 — The Save-to-Collection sheet's confirm button is physically unclickable (P1, functional)\n\n**Verified.** In a real headless browser, at both tested viewports, the **Save Item** button's centre hit-tests to an element that is **not** the button. A real pointer/touch click therefore never reaches it.\n\n| Viewport | Button rect (top–bottom) | Sheet rect (top–bottom) | Bottom nav (top–bottom) | `elementFromPoint` at button centre | Occluded |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 390×844 mobile | 761–789 | 397–697 | 774–844 | `NAV` | **Yes** |\n| 1365×900 desktop | 805–833 | 460–722 | 830–900 | `SPAN` | **Yes** |\n\nRead the geometry: the sheet claims `top: 397, bottom: 697`, but its button renders at `761–789`. The button is laid out **64px below the sheet's own bottom edge**, in the region occupied by the sticky bottom nav. The button is enabled (`disabled: false`) and visible, so nothing about its own state warns the learner; the click is simply delivered to the nav instead.\n\n**Evidence (reproducible, no pointer events synthesised):**\n\n- `docs/audits/evidence/modal-occlusion/modal-occlusion-report.json` — baseline `main`.\n- `docs/audits/evidence/modal-occlusion-pr15-fix/modal-occlusion-report.json` — PR #15 head, with a collection selected so the button is enabled.\n- Screenshots: `save-sheet-mobile-390x844.png`, `save-sheet-desktop-1365x900.png` in both directories.\n- Harness: `scripts/modal-occlusion-probe.mjs`.\n\n### 2.1 Root cause (Verified by direct manipulation)\n\nThe sheet is a `fixed inset-0` overlay, but it is mounted **inside a FEED card** that carries `backdrop-blur-xl`:\n\n- `src/components/feed/FeedScreen.tsx:153` and `:162` — the feed card: `rounded-[2rem] bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl …`\n- `src/components/collections/SaveLikeButton.tsx:89` — renders `<SaveToCollectionModal …>` from inside that card.\n- `src/components/collections/SaveToCollectionModal.tsx:69` — the overlay: `fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs …`\n\nPer CSS, an element whose `backdrop-filter` is not `none` becomes the **containing block for its `position: fixed` descendants**. The feed card therefore captures the sheet's `fixed inset-0`, and `inset-0` resolves to the card's box — which is why the recorded sheet rect (397–697) does not match the button position (761–789). The card's own stacking context also traps the `z-50` overlay, so the app's sticky bottom nav (`z-40`, a sibling) paints over the sheet footer.\n\n**Decisive confirmation.** Neutralising the ancestor's backdrop filter — exactly what moving the sheet to a document-level portal would achieve — changed the outcome from failure to success with no other change:\n\n```\nBEFORE: {\"center\":[279,775],\"hit\":\"NAV\",\"isBtn\":false}\nAFTER neutralizing backdrop-filter: {\"hit\":\"SPAN\",\"isBtn\":false}   # sheet re-anchored to the viewport, button moved to 636-664\npointer click with stacking context neutralized: saved_items 0 -> 1\n```\n\nThe same script showed that dispatching the button's own DOM `.click()` also saves (`saved_items 0 -> 1`), which is why a script that bypasses hit-testing (a common Playwright workaround) reports success while a learner's real tap does nothing.\n\n### 2.2 Why PR #15's guard does not resolve it\n\n| Check | Baseline `main` | PR #15 (`ec4f48ef74`) |\n|---|---|---|\n| Save enabled with no collection | Yes (defect F-01) | **No — correctly disabled** |\n| Save enabled with a collection ticked | Yes | Yes |\n| Button centre hit-tests to the button | **No (`NAV`)** | **No (`NAV`)** |\n| Real pointer click saves the item | **No** | **No** (only a synthetic DOM click does) |\n\nPR #15 is a correct and necessary fix for F-01. It is **not sufficient** for the learner-facing flow: after ticking a collection, the button is enabled but still covered, so the sheet appears frozen. This is a second, independent finding rather than a re-report of F-01.\n\n### 2.3 Impact\n\n- The learner taps the enabled \"Save Item\" button and nothing happens; the sheet stays open with no feedback.\n- This affects **both** mobile and desktop, and every FEED card, not just the one exercised here.\n- It also invalidates any browser evidence that used a DOM-dispatched click to prove the save loop works, because that path is not what a learner does. The companion report's task-5 result must be read with this in mind: its FAIL is real, and a PASS obtained by force-clicking would be a false positive.\n\n### 2.4 Smallest safe fix (for a separate PR, not this audit)\n\nRender the sheet at document level so it is not captured by the feed card. The minimal, behaviour-preserving option is to portal it, e.g. mount `SaveToCollectionModal` (and the other `fixed inset-0` sheets) with `createPortal(..., document.body)`, or hoist it out of the blurred card in `FeedScreen`. Keep the visual markup and the `z-50` layer; do not change copy or the save logic. Add a regression test that **hit-tests** the button rather than dispatching a synthetic click, so the class of bug cannot return silently. This is a layout/portal change, so it belongs in its own PR and should be reviewed as a UI change, not folded into the typecheck or audit work.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Status of the other reported items at this checkpoint\n\nRe-checked against the live repository and API at 2026-10-22T11:36Z.\n\n| Item | Status | Evidence |\n|---|---|---|\n| F-01 save-with-no-collection | **Fix proposed** — PR #15 `ec4f48ef74`, guard verified, integrity 69/69 | PR #15; `npm run test:integrity` |\n| F-04 typecheck gate | **Fix proposed twice** — PR #11 `3abfa2e181` and PR #12 `25388f8188`; both CI-green | `npm run lint` on `main` = 11 errors (exit 1), reproduced; both PRs' runs `success` |\n| F-08 sheet occlusion | **Open, verified** — see §2 | occlusion probe JSON + screenshots |\n| F-02 branding, F-03 French copy | **Open, unchanged** | companion report §4 |\n| F-06 deployment identity | **Still Blocked** — no deployed URL; `amina.onrender.com/api/health` → 404; Pages site → 404; Pages API → 404 | live probes; `render.yaml` |\n| R1 audit report | **Delivered** on `audit/amina-forensic-2026-10-22` | `docs/audits/AMINA_FORENSIC_AUDIT_2026-10-22.md` |\n| R3 learner-flow evidence | **Delivered**, 9/10 PASS in the independent rerun; task 5 FAIL is F-08 | companion report §5; this addendum §2 |\n\n**R2 note (Observed-not-verified, needs an owner decision).** `main`'s `tsconfig.json` does **not** set `strict: true`. PR #12 adds `\"strict\": true` and `\"allowUnreachableCode\": false`; PR #11 fixes the same errors without tightening the config. Both make the gate blocking. \"Strict TypeScript gate\" is satisfied more literally by the PR that also turns on `strict`, but the two PRs overlap and one should be chosen and the other closed to avoid divergent fixes to the same files.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Boundary compliance for this addendum\n\n- No production change, no merge, no deployment.\n- PR #7, #8, #10, #11, #12, #13, #15 all left untouched.\n- No app source, curriculum content, branding, or HOME/FEED/LIBRARY/NOUR structure changed by this addendum; it adds one audit document and one probe script.\n- No dependency added to the app; Playwright/Chromium are used only by the audit tooling and are not in `package.json`.\n- Synthetic QA profile only; no real child or student data.\n",
